record.paper_title: Open problems in dynamics and related fields
record.original_question: Is every Anosov diffeomorphism topologically conjugate to a hyperbolic automorphism on an infranilmanifold?

evidence.quote: CONJECTURE 3. Every Anosov diffeomorphism is topologically conjugate to a hy-perbolic automorphism on an infranilmanifold.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a closed smooth manifold and $f: M \to M$ a diffeomorphism. Recall that $f$ is called Anosov if there exists a continuous $Df$-invariant splitting of the tangent bundle $TM = E^s \oplus E^u$ and constants $C > 0$, $0 < \lambda < 1$ such that for all $n \geq 0$,
$$\|Df^n v\| \leq C\lambda^n \|v\| \text{ for } v \in E^s, \qquad \|Df^{-n} v\| \leq C\lambda^n \|v\| \text{ for } v \in E^u.$$

An infranilmanifold is a manifold of the form $N/\Gamma$, where $N$ is a simply connected nilpotent Lie group and $\Gamma$ is a torsion-free discrete subgroup of $N \rtimes K$ (with $K$ a compact subgroup of $\mathrm{Aut}(N)$) acting freely and cocompactly on $N$, such that $\Gamma \cap N$ has finite index in $\Gamma$. An automorphism of an infranilmanifold is the diffeomorphism induced by an automorphism of $N$ that normalizes $\Gamma$; such an automorphism is called hyperbolic if its differential at the identity has no eigenvalues of modulus $1$.

Question: Is every Anosov diffeomorphism of a closed manifold topologically conjugate to a hyperbolic automorphism of an infranilmanifold? That is, does there always exist an infranilmanifold $N/\Gamma$, a hyperbolic infranilmanifold automorphism $A: N/\Gamma \to N/\Gamma$, and a homeomorphism $h: M \to N/\Gamma$ such that $h \circ f = A \circ h$?
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture that every Anosov diffeomorphism of a closed manifold is topologically conjugate to a hyperbolic infranilmanifold automorphism remains a major open problem. The only known examples are of this form, and partial results exist: the conjecture is established for codimension-one Anosov diffeomorphisms and for Anosov diffeomorphisms already known to live on infranilmanifolds, and Anosov Lie algebras up to dimension 8 have been classified, but the general classification problem is unsolved for dimension greater than 3.

status_evidence.title: Anosov diffeomorphism - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: The problem of classifying manifolds that admit Anosov diffeomorphisms ... still has no answer for dimension over 3. The only known examples are infranilmanifolds, and it is conjectured that they are the only ones.
status_evidence.claim: The classification conjecture remains open beyond dimension 3.

status_evidence.title: Anosov diffeomorphisms on infra-nilmanifolds associated to graphs (Deré, 2023)
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work continues to study which infra-nilmanifolds admit Anosov diffeomorphisms, indicating the classification question is still active.
status_evidence.claim: Active ongoing research on Anosov diffeomorphisms on infranilmanifolds indicates the conjecture is open.
